## Positioning

Billy works between functional requirements and technical delivery. A functional consultant handles client communication; Billy refines the resulting requirements, challenges the proposed solution, improves architecture, process flow, and Fiori/UI5 UX, and remains involved through implementation, automated testing, QA, deployment, and troubleshooting.

Primary target roles: SAP BTP Technical Consultant, SAP Fiori/CAP Developer, SAP Full-Stack Engineer, Technical Delivery Engineer.
Secondary target roles: Backend Engineer, Platform Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer, AI-enabled Full-Stack Engineer.
Languages: Spanish (native), English (B2 professional working proficiency).

## Current experience

BeCloud Consulting — SAP Consultant — January 2025 to present.
Practical scope: requirement refinement with a functional consultant; solution architecture and full-stack delivery across SAP BTP, Fiori/UI5, CAP/CDS, Work Zone, HANA, Joule, integrations, and distributed deployments. Billy also introduced automated testing and a dedicated QA stage in a workflow that previously relied on direct dev/production fixes, and coordinates validation with QA and design.

Happ Rent — Full-Stack Developer — October 2023 to September 2024.
Scope: product delivery across frontend and backend in a rental-technology environment.

## Selected evidence

Confidential enterprise SAP work: technical delivery from refined requirements through architecture, implementation, automated testing, QA, and environment troubleshooting. Client and project names are intentionally omitted.

Confidential cloud platform: evaluated the economics and technical fit of an AWS direction, recommended a clean re-platform to Google Cloud, and aligned stakeholders around the decision. Work is in progress; no completed outcome is claimed.

Clinipets: privately developed B2B2C veterinary platform with clinic isolation, conflict-safe scheduling, versioned and auditable clinical records, signed/idempotent payment flows, secure attachment quarantine, notifications, web/mobile clients, and Docker-based infrastructure. Selected screens can be shared in interviews; the repository remains private.

SAP CAP + Fiori Reference Application: independent open SAP BTP reference with CDS modeling, OData V4, Fiori Elements, XSUAA/HANA deployment design, an external OData service with controlled degradation, three architecture decision records, and 12 service tests covering role authorization, concurrent stock protection, and provider-failure behavior; lint, production build, and GitHub Actions CI pass: https://github.com/Billyflin/sap-cap-fiori-btp
Integration Suite boundary: ADR 0003 is explicitly a proposed, non-deployed design exercise. It covers transactional outbox delivery from CAP, a versioned event contract, receiver-side idempotency, bounded retries, business-versus-technical error handling, quarantine/replay, least-privilege credentials and end-to-end correlation toward an S/4HANA API. It must not be interpreted as claimed production CPI experience: https://github.com/Billyflin/sap-cap-fiori-btp/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-integration-suite-delivery-blueprint.md

Grounded Knowledge Assistant: independent Next.js/TypeScript RAG engineering reference with evidence gating, safe refusals, validated citations, 12 automated and adversarial tests, deterministic committed-fixture evaluations at 100% hit@3, support/refusal accuracy, and citation validity, plus an optional server-only OpenAI provider and a human-verified AI delivery protocol requiring reproducible evidence, complete diff review, no sensitive prompts, and explicit limitations; lint, strict types, tests, evaluations, production build, and GitHub Actions CI pass. These are fixture metrics, not production claims: https://github.com/Billyflin/grounded-knowledge-assistant

UFRO Sustentable: open Kotlin/Firebase Android team project with maps, QR, rewards, BDD/Cucumber, and 83 JVM tests. The repository documents 89.23% line coverage and 77.88% branch coverage: https://github.com/Billyflin/ufro-sustentable
